title: Unfold a desk lamp to illuminate a book
instruction: Unfold the desk lamp and turn it on to illuminate the book. Place the entire base inside the red tape rectangle. Raise the bottom of the shade at least 20 cm above the table and level its downward-facing light surface within 15 degrees. Tap the sun symbol once to turn on the light. Complete within 120 seconds.
context: Preparing a compact reading light requires one hand to steady and position its base while the other unfolds passive hinges and adjusts the shade. The task combines two-handed manipulation with a contact-operated switch in an everyday desk setup.
setup: Fixed dual-arm YAM station, wood-look table, open READY grippers; tabletop z=0.7475 m. Plastic lamp with steel pins and rubber feet: 76x140 mm base and shade, two 106 mm links, 200 g, three folded passive hinges; XY=(0.50,0.18) m, yaw -90 deg. Closed paper novel: 180x110x20 mm, 200 g, XY=(0.34,0) m. Red paper tape: 96x160 mm inner rectangle, 4 mm strips, XY=(0.43,0.16) m, yaw -29.36 deg; 10 mm margin around the base. Robot faces +X, left is +Y. Ambient lights are at 50%; lamp off.
scoring: Binary 1 if the final state meets all four conditions within 120 s: the entire base footprint is inside the red tape frame; the shade/diffuser bottom is at least 20 cm above the tabletop; the emitting face points down within 15 degrees of horizontal; and the lamp is on. Otherwise 0. Position is judged only by frame containment.
run_limit: 2,400 control steps at 20 Hz (120 simulated seconds), including 32 initial history steps. The scripted demo uses 30 Hz with the same 120-second limit.
reset_notes: Restore READY arms and open grippers, folded lamp and book poses; zero velocities and hinge angles; lamp off. Clear touch state and elapsed time. Settle for 1 s before a model trial. Seed 0; fixed layout without object jitter.
fidelity: CPU PhysX PGS at 480 Hz; free four-body lamp, three passive friction hinges, no drives or world fixation. Approximate product geometry; estimated masses/friction, rigid plastic and paper, convex collisions. Tape is visual only. Contact toggles an RTX light; brightness is not calibrated lux. Expert uses simulator state. Dream sees three RGB cameras (640x360 resized to 320x176) and joint positions.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0 after 120 s (lamp off, too low and outside frame). Scripted demo: 1.0 in 82.7 s; final shade height 22.368 cm, face tilt 2.219 deg. Both scores use the final rubric.
